description_en: Detects the outline data, attributes, and license plate information of vehicles in an image. The vehicle attributes include the vehicle color (CarColor) and vehicle type (CarType). The license plate information includes the recognition content (Content) and plate frame (Boundary)
description_zh: 检测指定图像中的车辆边界信息、车辆属性信息、车牌信息。车辆属性信息包括：车辆颜色（CarColor）、车辆类型（CarType）；车牌信息包括：车牌识别内容（Content）、车牌框信息（Boundary）
kebab_example: aliyun imm detect-image-cars --project-name test-project --source-uri oss://test-bucket/test-object.jpg --credential-config example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetectImageCars

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html operation
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The URI of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket in which you store the image file.

Specify the value in the oss://${Bucket}/${Object} format. `${Bucket}` specifies the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project. `${Object}` specifies the complete path to the file that has an extension
parameters.help_zh:
文件的OSS存储地址。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径
parameters.name: source_uri

fields.help_en: The service role in the account that is used to call an IMM API operation. The role must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You can configure permissions for the role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console
fields.help_zh: 服务角色，调用IMM接口的账号需要创建的一个角色，必须包含 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行配置
fields.name: service_role

fields.help_en: The policy that is attached to the role specified by the ServiceRole parameter. For example, the policy allows access to OSS. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: ServiceRole参数的角色所需配置的权限策略，例如允许访问OSS。可选
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en: The ID of the account that you use to grant permissions
fields.name: assume_role_for

fields.help_en: The RAM role that can be assumed
fields.name: role

fields.help_en:
The role type. Valid values:

user: Alibaba Cloud account.
service: Alibaba Cloud service
fields.help_zh:
角色类型，可选值如下。
user：阿里云账号。
service：阿里云服务
fields.name: role_type

fields.help_en: The authorization chains. All roles in the array must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You need to only grant other permissions, such as read and write permissions on OSS, to the last role in the array. You can grant permissions in the RAM console
fields.help_zh:
需要传递授权的链列表，数组中的所有角色都需要赋予访问 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。
只有数组中的最后一个角色需要额外配置需要真正访问的其他权限，比如OSS的读写权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行授权操作
fields.name: chain

parameters.help_en:
If you do not have special requirements, leave this parameter empty.

The authorization chain. This parameter is optional. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.help_zh:
如无特殊需求，请保持留空即可。

链式授权配置，非必填。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.name: credential_config
